paite: "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh belam huang kongkhak a lut lou a, lampi dang a kahlutmi guta leh suamhat ahi.
heading: Belamchingpa Gentehna
english: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.

paite: Kuapeuh kongkhak a lut belamchingpa ahi.
english: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

paite: Kongkhak ngakpa'n amah ana honsak a; belamte'n a-aw aza uh; ama'n belamte amin un asam chiat a, apikhe zel hi.
english: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

paite: Amah a tengteng apawtsaktak in, ama uh akai a, belamte'n amah azui zel ua, a-aw athei uhi.
english: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.

paite: Midang azui kei ding ua, ataimangsan zaw ding uh; midangte aw atheih louh ziak un,” achi hi.
english: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”

paite: Hiai gentehna Jesu'n akiang uah agen hi; himahleh bang thu ahia akiang ua agen chih athei kei uhi.
english: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n akiang uah agen nawn a, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kei belam kongkhak ka hi.
heading: Jesu Belamchingpa Hoih
english: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.

paite: Ka ma a hong pai tengteng gutate leh suamhatte ahi vek uh; himahleh belamte'n athu uh angaihsak kei uh.
english: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.

paite: Kei kongkhak ka hi; keimah a mi alutleh, humbit in a-om ding a, alut in apawt dia, nek ding leng amu ding hi.
english: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.

paite: Guta zaw, gu ding leh that ding leh hihse ding lou in ahong pai kei; kei ka hihleh hinna aneihna ding ua, tampitak aneihna ding ua hong pai ka hi.
english: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

paite: "Kei belamchingpa hoih ka hi; belamchingpa hoih in abelamte a ding in ahinna apia hi.
english: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

paite: Kilohmi, belamchingpa tak hilou, belamte amah a hilou in, ngia hong pai amuh in belamte ataisan a; huan ngia in amau akei a, huchi in belamte ahihdalh hi.
english: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.

paite: Kilohmi ahi a, belamte a ding a deihsakna himhim aneih louh ziak in ataimang hi.
english: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn’t care for the sheep.

paite: Kei zaw belamchingpa hoih ka hi.
english: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;

paite: Pa in ahon theih bang in ke'n leng Pa ka thei hi, huan belamte a ding in ka hinna ka pia hi.
english: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

paite: Hiai belam huang a lou belam dangte ka nei hi; amau leng ka hon pi ding a, ka aw aza ding ua, hon khat in chingpa khat toh a-omkhawm ding uhi.
english: I have other sheep which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

paite: "Hiai ziak in Pa'n kei ahon it ahi; lak nawn ding a ka hinna ka piak ding ziak in.
english: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.

paite: Kuamah in hon laksak kei ding, keimah thuthu in ka pe zaw ding hi. Pe thei ka hi a, la nawn thei leng ka hi. Hiai thupiak ka Pa a pan ka muh ahi,” achi hi.
english: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”

paite: Hiai thu ziak in Judate akikhen ua, akilang nawnta uhi.
english: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.

paite: Akhen tampi in, "Dawi zawl ahi, ahai ei ve; bangziak a athu ngaikhia na hi ua?" achi uhi.
english: Many of them said, “He has a demon and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”

paite: Akhen in, "Hiai dawi zawl thute hi kei e. Dawi in mittaw mit ahihvak thei a hia?" achi uhi.
english: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”

paite: Huan Jerusalem a Latna Ankuanglui lai ahi a, huai hun phalbi lai ahi.
heading: Jesu Nawlkhin In A-om
english: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.

paite: Tempul, Solomon inlim ah Jesu akivialleh hi.
english: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.

paite: Judate'n hong umkual ua, akiang ah, "Bang tan lakloh tak a hon koih ding na hia? Khrist na hihleh chiantak in hon hilh in," achi uhi.
english: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ka hon hilhta a, na gingta tuan kei uh; ka Pa min a thil ka hih hiaite'n ka tanchin atheisak uhi.
english: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.

paite: Himahleh na gingta kei uhi, ka belam lak a mi na hih louh ziak un.
english: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

paite: Ka belamte'n ka aw aza uh, ke'n leng amaute ka thei a, amau ahon zui uhi.
english: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

paite: Akiang uah tangtawn hinna ka pia; tangtawn in amangthang himhim kei ding ua, kuamah in ka khut a kipan hon sut sam kei ding hi.
english: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

paite: Amau hon pepa ka Pa, mi tengteng sang a thupizaw ahi; kuamah in Pa khut a kipan asut thei kei ding hi.
english: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.

paite: Kei leh Pa lah pum khat ka hi uh," chi in adawng hi.
english: I and the Father are one.”

paite: Huan Judate'n adenna ding in suang atawm nawn uhi.
heading: Judate'n Jesu Ahua Uh
english: Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

paite: Jesu'n amau ahoupih a, "Pa a kipan nasep hoih tampi ka hon ensak a, huai nasepte lak ah bang nasep ziak in ahia suang a na hon den dek uh?" achi hi.
english: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”

paite: Judate'n akiang ah, "Nasep hoih ziak in suang in ka hon dengdek kei uh; Pathian na gensiat ziak leh nang mihing hi ngal a, Pathian a na kibawl ziak ahi zaw," chi in adawng uhi.
english: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na dan uah, 'noute pathiante na hi uh ka hon chi,' chih gelh ahi kei a hia?
english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?

paite: Pathian thu tunnate bawn pathiante achihleh Laisiangthou bohsiat theih ahi kei hi.
english: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),

paite: Pathian Tapa ka hi, ka chih ziak in Pa'n aseh a, khovel a asawlpa Pathian na gensia hon chi na hi uh maw?
english: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?

paite: Ka Pa nasem ka hih keileh hon gingta kei un.
english: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.

paite: Himahleh sem ka hihleh kei hon gingta kei mah le uchin ka nasepte bek gingta un; huchi a keimah ah Pa a-om chih leh kei Pa ah ka om chih na theihna ua, na theihsiamna ding un," chi in adawng hi.
english: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”

paite: Huaitak in mat atum nawn ua, himahleh akhut ua kipan asuakta hi.
english: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

paite: Jordan lui gal ah Johan in atung a mi abaptisna lam ah apaimang nawn a, huai ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.

paite: Huan akiang ah mi tampi ahong pai ua, "Johan in thillamdang bangmah ahih kei a; himahleh Johan in hiai mi tungtang thu agen peuhmah ana dik mahmah hi," achi uhi.
english: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”

paite: Huan huai ah mi tampi in amah agingta uhi.
english: Many believed in him there.
